## Experience

- Quality Analyst — Pagesuite India Pvt Ltd (Sep 2024 – Present): functional and regression testing of e-paper, magazine and article modules; automation with TestSigma, Selenium and Appium; smoke testing for daily releases; Google Analytics and Charles Proxy debugging; iOS TestFlight validation; BrowserStack cross-browser testing.
- Automation and Manual Tester — Sankey Business Solutions Pvt Ltd (Nov 2022 – Sep 2024): designed automation frameworks for the printing and logistics domain; led testing of print-management software; validated supply-chain workflows on web and mobile.
